title: tiny.london
author: Boris Starkov
description: All of Greater London as one isometric pixel-art map, drawn by a fine-tuned image model from Google's 3D map.

title: Isometric NYC
author: Andy Coenen
description: New York in the style of SimCity 2000, drawn tile by tile by a fine-tuned image model. The map that started the rest.

title: Isometric Istanbul
author: Yahya Bedirhan Pak
description: Both sides of the Bosphorus, from the city's own 3D model, redrawn by a fine-tuned Qwen model following the tiny.london method.

title: Pixel Berlin
author: Rupert Hoffschmidt-McDonnell
description: All of Berlin as one muted isometric map, redrawn from Google's 3D map by a Qwen LoRA, with address search.

title: Isometric Warsaw
author: Bedirhan Yildirim
description: The whole of Warsaw in pixel art, drawn live in the browser from open data, with trams and trains on their timetables.

title: HypeSeoul
author: bitjaru
description: All of Seoul as one isometric painting by a fine-tuned image model, with day and night on Seoul time and live subway trains.

title: tinygyn
author: Thomas M.
description: Goiânia redrawn as an isometric pixel-art map from the city's 3D model.

title: tinyrj
author: Thomas M.
description: Rio de Janeiro redrawn as an isometric pixel-art map from the city's 3D model, with planes to fly over it.

title: Tiny Stockholm
author: Audrius
description: Stockholm, Solna and Sundbyberg, redrawn with the tiny.london LoRA, with trains, buses and boats on their timetables.

title: tiny detroit
author: Gabriel
description: The whole City of Detroit as one pixel-art map painted by a Qwen LoRA, with the QLine and the People Mover.

title: tiny.blr
author: Rithvik
description: Greater Bengaluru from Google's 3D map, with Namma Metro, wards and weather; the pixel art is still being drawn.

title: SimCABA
author: Nicolás Poore
description: Buenos Aires in the style of SimCity, from more than 12,000 generated pictures.

title: pixis
author: @nfmelendez
description: An arcade flight over an isometric pixel-art Neuquén, taking off from the Monumento a la Bandera.

title: earthToPixels
author: Tiago Trindade
description: João Pessoa in the style of SimCity, from Google's 3D map through a fine-tuned open Qwen model.

title: Isopolis
author: nuwandavek
description: San Francisco as one giant isometric pixel painting by a custom model, with tours and postcards.

title: SF Isometric
author: Justin Chavez
description: A small square of North Beach round Coit Tower, redrawn as an isometric pixel-art mosaic.

title: SimLeón
author: Enrique
description: León, Guanajuato in the style of SimCity 2000, drawn from Google's 3D map in a palette of 256 colours.

title: CDMX Isométrica
description: Mexico City in pixel art, drawn in the browser from OpenStreetMap, from the Centro Histórico to Xochimilco.

title: Tiny Vancouver
description: A sunny pixel-art Vancouver with place labels, evening light and a small flight mode.

title: tiny tashkent
author: Shahzod
description: All of Tashkent as an illustrated isometric map from real streets and buildings, searchable in Latin or Cyrillic.

author: Josh
description: Rotterdam in miniature from the city's 3D model, with sunlight, lit windows at night and the weather now.

title: Abidjan en miniature
author: Opriel
description: Le Plateau drawn building by building from OpenStreetMap and aerial photos, redrawn by Codex, with its towers named.

title: Isometric Málaga
author: Brosax
description: The Mediterranean coast, the cathedral, the port, La Malagueta bullring and Gibralfaro hill, about 2.4 gigapixels of pixel art.

title: Isometric Amsterdam
author: sezer
description: Amsterdam's historic centre with all 68,543 buildings at their real heights, canals, parks and trees; the landmarks are being redrawn one by one from photos.

title: Tiny Warsaw
author: Dominik Roszkowski
description: Warsaw as a low-poly 3D diorama built from OpenStreetMap, GUGiK heights and the city's tree map, with hand-modelled landmarks, live flights at Okęcie, day and night light, rides and multiplayer flying.

title: London, drawn
author: Akash Wadhwani
description: 216 square kilometres of central London redrawn by AI from Google's 3D map, one 700-metre square at a time, with 183 buildings you can open.
